name: Zoho Desk
shortInfo: Manage customer conversations across multiple channels, such as email, chat, phone, social media
brief: Zoho Desk is a cloud based help desk software for small, mid-size and large enterprises to enhance their customer support and business efficiency. It manages customer conversations across multiple channels, such as email, chat, phone, social media, etc.The Zoho Desk Connector lets you sync data from Zoho Desk API to your data warehouse automaticallyZoho Desk APIs facilitate integration with other Zoho applications and third-party tools by adhering to RESTful principles. These APIs enable you to programmatically fetch and edit data in the different modules in Zoho Desk, such as Tickets, Contacts, Accounts and so on. All the APIs follow HTTP rules and error codes
about:
Zoho Desk helps you simplify customer service operations, improve agent productivity, and deliver lasting customer experiences. Deliver happiness to your customers and get them to adore you! Desk helps you be more accessible to your customers, provide them with quick resolutions, and make doing business with you convenient.  
  
Learn more about [Zoho Desk API documentation.](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)
availableData:
[Agents](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/pipelines/agents.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve details of an agent in your help desk.

[Insights - Agent Resolution Time](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/pipelines/insights-agent-resolution-time.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the durations taken to resolve tickets.

[Insights - Agent Response Time](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/pipelines/insights-agent-response-time.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the durations taken to respond to tickets.

[Insights - Closed Tickets](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/pipelines/insights-closed-tickets.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the number of tickets that are resolved.

[Insights - Created Tickets](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/pipelines/insights-created-tickets.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the number of tickets created in a particular duration.

[Insights - On Hold Tickets](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/pipelines/insights-onhold-tickets.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the number of tickets that are in the on hold status.

[Insights - Reopened Tickets](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/pipelines/insights-reopened-tickets.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the number of tickets that were reopened in your help desk portal.  
  
Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/zoho-desk/index.html) here.
